text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr and I are out walking
when we
spot Nishino Flower looking
down at a flower
bed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The very last one has fallen... Thank you,
for
everything.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Flower. Are you tending to the
flowers?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The flowers here are already out of
season,
though, so they've all wilted.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Is that so... I still vividly remember the
balmy
breeze that blew when they were
in full bloom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Zephyr. That means a lot.
And I'm
sure the flowers appreciate you
saying that too!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Trainer? ...It really is sad that
they're
gone now. I can't believe we'll
never see them
again.
choice_data_list: You were comforting me too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we should have them remain
with us
forever, as the wind and moon
do.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And as we look back on the memories
we have of
them, we can whip up some
opportune airstreams.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr picks up some fallen
petals, and
Nishino Flower follows her
example. After they've
collected all of
them...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, so what do we do with these?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even after petals have fallen, they can
still make
for a radiant breeze. Let's
allow them to regain
their elegant air
once more.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
First, we'll put these flower petals in a
pot of
water, and then heat it up.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: We're going to boil them?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I know! Are we making them into a
dye?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We can color this white
handkerchief.
Then, the still will give
way to a light breeze once
more.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I, too, would like to be embraced by
that floral
wind once more.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A wind both vibrant and cheerful.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Vibrant and cheerful...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You're in bloom! Hehe. I'm so
glad!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Look at all your bright colors. Ehehe.
Just seeing
you all puts me in such a
good mood.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to make a dye that's the same
bright color
this flower was when it first
bloomed.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
That same dazzling color it had after
bathing for
days and days in the
sunshine!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes... I remember that color too. It was a
radiant
breeze, and so very vivid.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Well, we'd better work briskly. If we
take too
long, the color of the dye will
turn out dull.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Okay! We'll make it a wonderful color
for sure!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I can already feel its fragrant
breeze
gently caressing my cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Did you happen to give this flower a
name?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
A name? Now that I think about it, no, I
didn't...
What would you name it?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Just looking at it warms my heart, so I
think
"Little Cozy" is good.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Little Cozy! ...Hehe. That's a lovely
name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After dying the handkerchief, we head
back to
the flowerbed while it dries.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
This is such a wonderful handkerchief...
and it's all
thanks to Little Cozy. Now we
can always be
together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fallen flowers become seeds, and life
begins
again. Let's help the new breath
of life blow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr begins planting seeds
in the
flowerbed.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...And now we wait for the winds to show
us what
kind of flowers will blossom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Agreed!
choice_data_list: May they grow big and strong!
I'm sure it'll grow strong roots.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We'll need some good fertilizer to
help
with that. Perhaps a local gardener
will share
some with us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr and Nishino Flower
eagerly hurry
off to find some fertilizer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they should. The soil is very rich.
See? Look
at this lively little worm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it's so big!
Take care of the
flowers for us, little wormie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Imagining the flowers growing up big
and strong
with beautiful petals,
Yamanin Zephyr and
Nishino Flower
smile to each other.
